title: Cristiano Ronaldo at the World Cup
description: Portugal's all-time great across five World Cups.

questions.q: Cristiano Ronaldo became the first player to score at how many different World Cups?
questions.explain: He scored at the 2006, 2010, 2014, 2018 and 2022 tournaments.

questions.q: At which World Cup did Ronaldo make his debut?
questions.explain: He debuted for Portugal at Germany 2006.

questions.q: How many World Cups has Ronaldo won?
questions.explain: Despite his greatness, Ronaldo never won the World Cup.

questions.q: Ronaldo scored a memorable hat-trick against which team in 2018?
questions.explain: His hat-trick earned a 3–3 draw with Spain in Portugal's opener.

questions.q: Portugal's best World Cup finish, with Ronaldo's debut, was reaching the…
questions.explain: Portugal reached the 2006 semi-finals, losing to France.

questions.q: At the 2022 World Cup, Portugal were knocked out in the quarter-finals by whom?
questions.explain: Morocco beat Portugal 1–0 on their run to the semi-finals.

questions.q: Ronaldo was controversially benched for a 2022 knockout game won 6–1 against whom?
questions.explain: Gonçalo Ramos starred with a hat-trick against Switzerland.

questions.q: Which country does Cristiano Ronaldo represent?
questions.explain: Ronaldo is Portugal's all-time leading scorer and captain.
